reason: The only candidate is Pieter Andreas Johannes Swanepoel. His given names are entirely different from Hendrik Frederik, so he is not this man.
Andries Johannes Erwee of Swellendam is an exact match on full name and district, and there is no competing candidate.

Willem Steenkamp of Clanwilliam matches the genealogy's single given name exactly, in the same district. Willem Jacobus (C08) carries an extra unrecorded name, and the other Willem-related entries are sons of a Willem.

Johannes Petrus Jordaan of Somerset matches the second and third names of Christoffel Johannes Petrus in the same order and district. Omitting a first name is plausible, and no other candidate fits better.
No Uitenhage Scheepers owner is named Marthinus Easias. Johannes Martinus has a different first name and lacks Easias, which is too weak to count as a match.
Johannes Petrus Pretorius of Somerset is an exact match on given names and declared district. That fits the elder Jan Sr., married in 1804.
The only Hendrik is Hendrik Ferdinand of Graaff-Reinet. His second name, Ferdinand, contradicts Johannes, and a shared first name alone is weak, so no candidate is more likely than not.
Pieter Daniel Jacobs of Beaufort is noted as son of Pieter (Pieter jr). This agrees with the genealogy father, Pieter Daniel Sr., and with the man being the junior.
Jacobus Francois Joubert of Swellendam is an exact name and district match, and he is the only candidate with these given names.
Christoffel Jacobus Botha of Somerset matches the first two names and the district, with the third name simply omitted. C02's third name, Lodewyk, contradicts Theunis.
